descriptionHtml:
I joined TikTok’s GMPT Transaction Platform team as an AI Engineer, working on Transaction Agent. My focus is building high-performance knowledge bases, automating skill generation, and developing offline pipelines for agent evaluation and self-improvement, with the goal of building a self-improving agent.
我加入了 TikTok GMPT 旗下的 Transaction Platform 团队，担任 AI 工程师，从事 Transaction Agent 研发。工作聚焦于高性能知识库建设、Skill 自动生成，以及 Agent 评测与自提升的离线链路，目标是构建能够持续自我改进的 Agent。

I gave a presentation on recommendation systems at the student learning hub event held by C2smarter Center.
我在C2smarter Center 举办的student learning hub活动中，做了关于推荐系统的分享。

Excited to share that I’ve accepted a 2026 spring internship offer from TikTok! I’ll be joining the e-commerce recommendation infrastructure team, focusing on Feature Service and User data accessor.
我很高兴地告诉大家，我已经接受了Tiktok 2026年春季实习的邀请！我将加入电子商务推荐基础设施团队，专注于功能服务和用户数据访问。

Excited to share that I’ve accepted a 2025 summer internship offer from TikTok! I’ll be joining the e-commerce team, working on recommendation infrastructure.
我已拿到 TikTok 的暑期实习 offer，2025 年暑假将在 TikTok 电商部门从事推荐系统架构的相关工作。

I updated my photography works in my website.
我在网站上更新了自己的摄影作品。

I started my research on automated deployment with AI (CI/CD)!
我开始了关于AI结合的自动化部署（CI/CD）的研究！

I'm happy to share that I have started my Developer Assistant job in C2SMARTER Center!
我很高兴地告诉大家，我已经在C2SMARTER Center开始了我的开发助理工作！

I got 3.8 GPA for my frist semester!
我在NYU的第一学期的GPA是3.8 ！

My paper Federated Multi-view Multi-Label Classification was accepted by IEEE TBD.
我作为第一作者的论文《Federated Multi-view Multi-Label Classification》被IEEE TBD接受。

I started my work and research on deepfake detection!
我开始了关于深度伪造检测的工作和研究！

I'm happy to share that I've started my master of computer science at New York University!
我很高兴地告诉大家，我已经开始在纽约大学攻读计算机科学硕士学位了！
